import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.HasseDeriv
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Taylor
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.ToLinearEquiv
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Wronskian
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Vandermonde
import Mathlib.Data.ZMod.Defs
import Mathlib.Algebra.Field.ZMod
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Group.Int.Sum
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Polynomial
namespace DistinctDegreeGuards
open Polynomial
noncomputable abbrev family : Fin 2 → (ℤ × ℤ)[X] := ![monomial 0 (1, 0), monomial 1 (0, 1)]
theorem domain_needed :
    (∀ ν, family ν ≠ 0) ∧
    Function.Injective (fun ν ↦ ((family ν).natDegree : ℤ × ℤ)) ∧
    (Matrix.of fun μ ν : Fin 2 ↦ hasseDeriv (μ : ℕ) (family ν)).det = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro ν
    fin_cases ν <;> simp [family]
  constructor
  · intro i j hij
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp_all [family]
  · norm_num [family, Matrix.det_fin_two, hasseDeriv_monomial]
    rw [← C_mul]
    rfl
#print axioms domain_needed
end DistinctDegreeGuards
